title: Sebastián Elgueta Godoy — Research releases
description: Versioned, citable public research datasets by Sebastián Elgueta Godoy.

items.title: Latin America Digital Infrastructure — v0.2.0
items.content_text: Comparative dataset and observatory on data centers, cloud regions, IXPs, submarine connectivity, energy and institutional conditions across eight Latin American benchmark markets. Current and citable release: v0.2.0.

items.title: Chile Digital Inclusion — v0.1.0
items.content_text: Communal dataset on digital inclusion, household connectivity, broadband, fixed and mobile infrastructure, education connectivity and observed network performance across Chile. Current and citable release: v0.1.0.

items.title: Atlas de la Desconexión Digital de Chile 2026 — v0.1.0
items.content_text: Territorial research and public dataset on digital exclusion, connectivity, digital fragility and vulnerability in Chile, associated with the Digital Vulnerability Index. Current and citable release: v0.1.0.

items.title: Velocidades de Internet — Chile, Colombia y comparadores internacionales — v0.1.0
items.content_text: Longitudinal analytical dataset on fixed and mobile Internet speeds from 2008 to 2026, preserving the methodological separation between Akamai and Ookla. Current and citable release: v0.1.0.

items.title: Chile State Institutional Map — v0.1.0
items.content_text: Machine-readable institutional map of the Chilean State for public affairs, public policy, regulatory analysis and stakeholder mapping. Current and citable release: v0.1.0.

items.title: Stakeholder Routes Chile — v0.2.0
items.content_text: Decision-route dataset for public affairs and investment projects in Chile, mapping regulatory pathways by actor, stage, competence, conditionality and decision point. Current GitHub release: v0.3.0; latest citable snapshot: v0.2.0.
